info.title: eXist-db Platform API
info.description: Unified REST API for eXist-db: query execution, language services, database management, user management, package management, search, and cross-app linking.

tags.name: System
tags.description: System information, scheduler, and test runner

tags.name: Query
tags.description: XQuery execution with cursor-based result pagination

tags.name: Language Service
tags.description: Language services for XQuery (diagnostics, completions, hover, etc.). Data shapes are inspired by the Language Server Protocol but consumed over HTTP/JSON.

tags.name: Site
tags.description: Site-level app listing and cross-app link resolution

get.description: Returns database, Java, and OS information. No authentication required. Replaces xst's info.xq.

200.description: System information including database version, Java runtime, and operating system details

get.description: Returns all scheduled jobs from the eXist-db scheduler. Used by Dashboard's System tab.

200.description: Scheduled jobs with trigger states and timing information

post.description: Runs XQSuite tests on a stored XQuery module. Returns the test results as HTML.

source.description: DB path to the XQSuite test module

200.description: Test results with pass/fail counts and XML output

source.description: DB path of the test module

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid source parameter

404.description: Test module not found at the given path

post.description: Compiles and evaluates an XQuery expression, returning a cursor ID for paginated result retrieval. The cursor must be closed when no longer needed.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

context-item.description: Serialized XML to use as the context item — the node `expression` will see as `.` / the focus of unprefixed path expressions like `//foo`. Use when the editor has unsaved buffer content not yet stored in the database. Ignored when `context-path` is also supplied.

context-path.description: DB path (e.g. `/db/apps/foo/data.xml`) to a document to use as the context item. Convenience shortcut over `context-item` when the editor's current document is already in the database. Takes precedence over `context-item`.

200.description: Query executed successfully; returns a cursor for result retrieval

cursor.description: Unique cursor ID for fetching results

400.description: Bad request — missing `query` field or malformed `context-item` XML

404.description: `context-path` was supplied but the document at that path doesn't exist

500.description: Server-side error during query compilation or evaluation. Body carries the structured XPathException fields (`code`, `description`, `line`, `column`, `module`, `value`) so clients can surface the real cause.

get.summary: Fetch page of results from cursor
get.description: Retrieves a page of serialized results from an open query cursor. Supports configurable start position, count, serialization method, and indentation.

200.description: Array of serialized result items with type information

delete.description: Closes an open query cursor and releases associated server-side resources. Should be called when the client is done fetching results.

404.description: Cursor not found or already closed

post.description: Attempts to cancel a currently running query. Not yet implemented — returns an error message.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Cursor ID of the running query

post.description: Compiles an XQuery expression and returns any syntax or static errors as diagnostics. Used by IDE integrations for real-time error checking.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

200.description: Array of diagnostic entries (empty if no errors)

post.description: Returns completion suggestions for an XQuery expression at the current cursor position. Includes functions, variables, and namespace prefixes.

expression.description: XQuery expression up to the cursor

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

example.label: fn:count#1
example.documentation: Returns the number of items in a sequence

post.description: Returns hover information (signature and documentation) for the symbol at the given line and column in the XQuery expression.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

200.description: LSP-shaped Hover: a map with one key, `contents`, whose value is a MarkupContent ({kind, value}) carrying Markdown-formatted documentation. Returns `null` (HTTP 200) if no symbol is found at the position.

contents.description: LSP MarkupContent — see the `MarkupContent` schema component.

value.description: The Markdown (or plaintext) body. For functions: a fenced XQuery code block with the signature, the description, a Parameters bullet list, and a Returns line.

contents.value:
```xquery
count($items as item()*) as xs:integer
```

Returns the number of items in the argument sequence.

**Parameters**

- `$items` (`item()*`) — The items

**Returns:** `xs:integer`

post.summary: Parameter help inside a function call
post.description: Returns LSP-shaped SignatureHelp for the function call surrounding the cursor: the call's signature, each parameter's label and per-parameter Markdown docs, plus an `activeParameter` index computed by counting commas at the call's paren depth. Returns `null` if the cursor is not inside a function-call argument list.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

200.description: LSP-shaped SignatureHelp, or `null` (HTTP 200) if the cursor is not inside a function call.

signatures.description: One entry per overload of the function at the cursor, sorted by arity ascending. For functions with a single arity, a single-element array.

label.description: Parameter label, designed to substring-match the signature label (e.g. `$arg as item()*`).

activeParameter.description: 0-based index of the parameter the cursor is on, computed by counting top-level commas between the opening paren and the cursor.

signatures.label: substring($sourceString as xs:string?, $start as xs:double) as xs:string

documentation.value: Returns the contiguous sequence of characters …

post.description: Resolves the definition location for the symbol at the given line and column. Returns the file URI, line, and column of the definition.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

200.description: Definition location of the referenced symbol

uri.description: DB path of the module containing the definition

post.description: Finds all references to the symbol at the given line and column within the current expression.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

post.description: Returns all symbols (functions, variables) defined in the given XQuery expression. Used for document outline views in IDEs.

module-load-path.description: Module load path for resolving imports

get.description: Lists the contents of a database collection including sub-collections and resources with metadata. Supports recursive listing, depth limits, and glob filtering.

parameters.name: glob
parameters.description: Glob pattern filter for resource names

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: 1-based offset of the first child to return (flat listing only)

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of children to return (flat listing only; default: all)

200.description: Collection metadata with children array. Each item carries a `writable` flag (whether the caller may write to it); resource items also carry `mime-type`. A flat (non-recursive) listing also carries `total` (full child count), `start` (1-based offset of this page) and `count` (items in this page).

get.description: Retrieves the content of a database resource (XML document, XQuery module, binary file, etc.) along with its MIME type and binary flag.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full DB path of the resource

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: Set to 'full' to flatten the resource's metadata (owner, group, mode, acl, size, created, last-modified) into the response alongside the content, sparing a separate /api/db/properties call

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Serialization method for XML resources. Omit to use the instance (conf.xml) default. Ignored for binary resources.

parameters.name: indent
parameters.description: Pretty-print the XML output. Omit to use the conf.xml default.

parameters.name: omit-xml-declaration
parameters.description: Omit the <?xml ...?> declaration. Omit to use the conf.xml default.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Output character encoding (e.g. UTF-8). Omit to use the conf.xml default.

parameters.name: media-type
parameters.description: Serialization media-type. Omit to use the conf.xml default.

parameters.name: item-separator
parameters.description: Separator string between serialized items. Omit to use the conf.xml default.

200.description: Resource content (always includes runPath). With meta=full, the resource's metadata fields are flattened in alongside the content. XML resources are serialized using any serialization parameters supplied (method/indent/omit-xml-declaration/encoding/media-type/item-separator); omitted parameters fall through to the conf.xml serializer defaults, so a request with no serialization parameters is byte-for-byte identical to before. NOTE: eXist's `expand-xincludes` is not yet supported here — as of eXist 7.0.0-beta3 it cannot be honored for node-to-string serialization, so it is intentionally omitted rather than silently expanding.

binary.description: Whether the resource is stored as binary

content.description: Resource content (text or base64-encoded for binary)

put.description: Stores or updates a resource in the database. The parent collection must exist. When `mime-type` is omitted the server looks up the appropriate MIME type for the path's filename extension via eXist's `mime-types.xml` (e.g. `.xq` → `application/xquery`, `.svg` → `image/svg+xml`, `.html` → `text/html`). Clients only need to send `mime-type` when they want to override that mapping (e.g. force an `.html` file to be stored as `application/xhtml+xml`).

path.description: Target DB path for the resource

mime-type.description: MIME type to store the resource as. When omitted the server looks up the path's filename extension in `mime-types.xml`. Supply this only to override that mapping.

stored.description: DB path of the stored resource

400.description: Bad request — missing path or content

delete.description: Deletes a resource from the database. Requires write permission on the parent collection.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full DB path of the resource to remove

removed.description: DB path of the removed resource

403.description: Insufficient permissions to remove the resource

post.description: Creates a new collection in the database. Parent collections are created automatically if they do not exist.

path.description: Full DB path for the new collection

created.description: DB path of the created collection

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid path

delete.description: Removes a collection from the database. Non-empty collections require the force parameter. Protected system collections cannot be removed.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full DB path of the collection to remove

removed.description: DB path of the removed collection

403.description: Insufficient permissions to remove the collection

409.description: Collection is not empty and force was not set

post.summary: Move or rename resource or collection
post.description: Moves or renames a resource or collection. The destination is given as an explicit `(parent, name)` pair — matching eXist's XML-RPC `moveResource` / `moveCollection` signature. Either `parent` or `newName` is required: `{source, parent}` moves into `parent` preserving source's leaf name; `{source, parent, name}` moves and renames; `{source, newName}` is a friendlier shortcut for in-place rename (equivalent to `parent = source's parent` + `name = newName`). `parent`, if supplied, must already exist as a collection.

source.description: DB path of the resource/collection to move

parent.description: Destination parent collection (must exist). Required unless `newName` is supplied.

name.description: Leaf name at the destination. Defaults to source's leaf when omitted.

newName.description: Shortcut for in-place rename. Equivalent to passing `parent = source's parent` and `name = newName`.

moved.description: Original path of the moved item

to.description: Full path of the moved item at its new location

400.description: Bad request — missing source or target

post.description: Copies a resource or collection. The destination is given as an explicit `(parent, name)` pair — matching eXist's XML-RPC `copyResource` / `copyCollection` signature. Either `parent` or `newName` is required: `{source, parent}` copies into `parent` preserving source's leaf name; `{source, parent, name}` copies and renames; `{source, newName}` is a friendlier shortcut for duplicating within source's own collection (equivalent to `parent = source's parent` + `name = newName`). `parent`, if supplied, must already exist as a collection.

source.description: DB path of the resource/collection to copy

parent.description: Destination parent collection (must exist). Required unless `newName` is supplied.

name.description: Leaf name for the copy. Defaults to source's leaf when omitted.

newName.description: Shortcut for duplicating within source's own collection under this leaf name. Equivalent to passing `parent = source's parent` and `name = newName`.

copied.description: Original path of the copied item

to.description: Full path of the copy at its new location

400.description: Bad request — missing source or target

get.description: Returns detailed properties of a resource or collection including ownership, permissions, MIME type, size, and timestamps.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Full DB path of the resource or collection

get.description: Returns a collection tree with lastModified timestamps. Supports incremental sync by filtering to resources modified after a given timestamp.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: ISO datetime — only return resources modified after this time

200.description: Hierarchical sync tree with timestamps for each item

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of this sync snapshot

post.description: Updates the owner, group, and/or mode of a resource or collection. Requires dba privileges or ownership of the item.

path.description: DB path of the resource or collection

mode.description: New permission mode, as a symbolic string. Three formats are accepted: (1) **simple symbolic** — `rwxr-xr-x` (9 characters covering user/group/other × read/write/execute); (2) **Unix symbolic** — relative form with `+`/`-`/`=` operators, e.g. `u+x,g-w` or `u=rwx,g=rx,o=r`; (3) **eXist symbolic** — verbose form like `user=+read,user=+write,group=+read,other=+read`. Octal strings (e.g. `0644`, `644`) are **not** accepted by the underlying `sm:chmod` string overload; clients that want to send a numeric mode must convert it to one of the symbolic forms first.

mime.description: New MIME (content) type for the resource (e.g. application/xml)

updated.description: DB path of the updated item

400.description: Bad request — missing path or invalid parameters

get.description: Returns importable modules from package-local files, mapped modules, and registered built-in modules. Used by IDE tools for import suggestions.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Current file's DB path (used to find package root)

200.description: Array of importable modules with their prefix, namespace, source, and origin

get.description: Returns the real and effective user identities and group memberships. Also serves as a capability probe: a 200 response indicates existdb-openapi is installed. Replaces xst's whoami.xq.

200.description: Current user identity with real and effective credentials

get.description: Returns all user accounts in the database with their group memberships and enabled status. Requires dba privileges.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Requires dba privileges. The user is automatically added to a personal group matching their username.

400.description: Bad request — missing required fields or user already exists

get.description: Returns detailed information about a user account including groups, primary group, enabled status, umask, and metadata.

put.description: Updates an existing user account. Can change password and/or group memberships. Requires dba privileges.

delete.description: Deletes a user account from the database. The user's personal group is also removed. Requires dba privileges.

403.description: Cannot remove system users or insufficient permissions

get.description: Returns all groups in the database with their managers and members. Requires dba privileges.

post.description: Creates a new group. The calling user is automatically added as a manager. Requires dba privileges.

400.description: Bad request — missing name or group already exists

get.description: Returns detailed information about a group including managers, members, and metadata.

200.description: Group details with managers, members, and metadata

delete.description: Deletes a group from the database. System groups (dba, guest) cannot be removed. Requires dba privileges.

403.description: Cannot remove system groups or insufficient permissions

get.description: Returns all EXPath packages installed in the database with detailed metadata including version, dependencies, components, and processor compatibility.

post.description: Installs a package from the public repository by name/URL, or from an uploaded .xar file. The package is deployed automatically after installation.

name.description: Package name (URI) to install from registry

version.description: Specific version to install (empty for latest)

400.description: Bad request — missing package name/URL or invalid .xar file

get.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single installed package identified by its abbreviation.

200.description: Package details (same shape as items in the package list)

delete.description: Undeploys and removes an installed package. Fails if other packages depend on it unless force=true is set.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force removal even if dependents exist

409.description: Other packages depend on this one — use force=true to override

example.error: Cannot remove: other packages depend on http://www.functx.com

post.description: Queries the public package repository to check whether newer versions are available for any installed packages.

200.description: Update availability report from the registry

get.description: Performs a full-text search across all installed applications. Results include snippets with highlighted matches and links to the source documents.

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Restrict to a single app via the site-app facet (e.g. docs, blog, notebook)

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Restrict to a section within an app via the site-section facet (e.g. functions, posts)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (page size)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return (for paging)

200.description: Search results with total count, relevance scores, and KWIC-highlighted snippets

query.description: The search query that was executed

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result in this page

facets.description: Facet counts for building a filter UI: each dimension maps facet values to hit counts.

results.description: Results ordered by descending relevance score

uri.description: Canonical DB path of the matching document (open over exist:)

path.description: DB path of the matching document (alias of uri)

score.description: Lucene relevance score (higher is more relevant)

snippet.description: First KWIC fragment as a well-formed XML string: a single <span> root with matched terms in <mark>. Parse with fn:parse-xml (no parse-xml-fragment needed); also valid HTML for innerHTML.

highlights.description: KWIC fragments centered on a match. Each is a well-formed XML string (a single <span> root with matched terms in <mark>), parseable with fn:parse-xml.

get.description: Returns all installed applications with their title, version, URL, and icon. Used for building navigation menus and app launchers.
Resolves a cross-application link by mapping an app abbreviation and path to the correct URL. Used for inter-app navigation without hardcoding paths.

200.description: Resolved URL for the cross-app link

post.summary: Evaluate query and return serialized results as plain text
post.description: Executes an XQuery expression and returns results serialized as plain text. Accepts the same serialization parameters as GET /api/query/{id}/results (method, indent, omit-xml-declaration, etc.). Designed for interactive try-it widgets where a single round-trip is preferred over the cursor pattern.

count.description: Maximum number of items to return

omit-xml-declaration.description: Whether to omit the XML declaration

200.description: Query results serialized as plain text

get.description: Returns the set of language-service features the running existdb-openapi instance supports.
